The Fatherhood Unveiled Podcast | Real Conversations. Hard Truths. Lasting Impact.

title: Retirement Calculator by State
author: 401k Calculator
description:
Where you live in retirement matters more than most people think. Two retirees can withdraw the same amount from their 401(k) each year. One keeps every dollar. The other sends a slice to the state. That is why a retirement calculator by state is not just a nice tool. It is a reality check.

Most online calculators ask for your savings, your age, and your expected return. They stop there. But state taxes on 401(k) withdrawals can range from zero to nearly 11 percent. On a $75,000 withdrawal, that gap can mean thousands of dollars a year . A good calculator should show you that difference before you decide where to retire.

The Perfect Predator: The Ted Bundy Story
What happens when a person who appears intelligent, charming, and completely ordinary hides a horrifying secret?

The Perfect Predator is a three-part true-crime podcast examining the disturbing story of Theodore Robert Bundy, one of America's most infamous serial killers. Behind his educated appearance and seemingly respectable personality was a violent criminal responsible for the deaths of numerous young women and girls across several American states.

This series takes listeners through Bundy's early life, the beginning of his crimes, the disappearance of innocent victims, and the investigations that gradually exposed his identity. It also explores his remarkable ability to manipulate people, his two escapes from custody, and the nationwide manhunt that followed.

As the investigation develops, the story reveals the importance of surviving victims, determined investigators, forensic evidence, and cooperation between law enforcement agencies.

The final episode examines Bundy's Florida crimes, courtroom proceedings, confessions, and execution in 1989.

Rather than glorifying a murderer, this podcast focuses on the victims, the failures that allowed the violence to continue, and the lessons this case left behind.

Three episodes. One terrifying criminal history. And the lives that must never be forgotten.

description:
Semper Virgo is Cardinal Raymond Leo Burke’s five-year preparation for the Quincentennial of the Apparitions of Our Lady of Guadalupe. This campaign of prayer and theological renewal is produced by the Shrine of Our Lady of Guadalupe in La Crosse, Wisconsin. This channel broadcasts daily Marian contemplations composed in the voice of Cardinal Burke, who invites you to join him in drawing nearer to Our Lady.


Semper Virgo is a rigorous, five-year cycle of daily meditations. Each year is given to one mystery of the Blessed Virgin Mary, beginning in Year One with the dogma of the Immaculate Conception.


Each day opens with Holy Writ, drawing from Saint Luke or Saint John, before tracing the Church's historical path through the verbatim writings of the Fathers, Doctors, Councils, and Popes. Every meditation concludes at Tepeyac, setting the mystery beside the miraculous image on the tilma of Saint Juan Diego.


We present the Church's Marian doctrine not as a list of abstract propositions, but as a living story. Subscribe to Semper Virgo to anchor your daily prayer in the truth and beauty of Catholic dogma. Dirty Hands 🙌 Clean Money 💰

title: Faith Friends and Fitness Y’all
author: FaithFriendsFitnessYall
description:
Faith, Friends & Fitness, Y’all is where faith, friendship, health, and real life come together.
Pull up a chair and join Kim for honest conversations about walking with Jesus, growing in faith, caring for the body God gave us, navigating relationships, finding purpose, and becoming the women God created us to be.
This isn’t about perfection. It’s about progress, grace, encouragement, and doing life together—with Jesus at the center.
So grab your coffee, open your Bible, and come sit a spell.
Pull up a chair, say a prayer, and let’s grow together! 💕🌸

title: I write music
author: Gerard Cousins and David John Roche
description: Welsh composers and guitarists David John Roche (www.davidjohnroche.com) and Gerard Cousins (www.gerardcousins.com) talk about their work as composers, writing music, performing music, and all of the problems in between.

title: Chloe and Friends | Calming Stories for Kids
author: Carlson & Co. Press
description:
Welcome to Chloe and Friends, a cozy storytelling podcast for kids about big feelings, little adventures, and growing up! 
Join Chloe, her best friend Bella, and her sister Snowball as they explore emotions like nervousness, frustration, excitement, and courage through heartwarming stories. Each episode includes calming moments, mindfulness, and gentle emotional check-ins to help children understand their feelings and build confidence. 
Perfect for bedtime, quiet time, car rides, or whenever your little one needs comfort. Because every feeling deserves a story!

title: Beyond A Reasonable Doubt with Jordan Cunningham
author: Ignition 36 Media
description:
What really happens when you're arrested? How well do you understand your constitutional rights? And how does the criminal justice system actually work?
Join attorney Jordan Cunningham of Cunningham Law Group and veteran broadcaster Mark Wilson as they explore the law, challenge common misconceptions, and reveal what happens inside and outside the courtroom.
From DUI arrests to criminal charges, bail, and the rights of the accused, Beyond A Reasonable Doubt makes complex legal issues understandable.
Because understanding your rights shouldn't require a law degree.

title: End of Usual
author: End of Usual
description:
End of Usual is a video podcast exploring how AI is changing the way we work and what it takes to make that change work for people and businesses.
Host Jess McDaid talks with leaders and operators about the decisions behind AI transformation: what they changed, why they changed it, and what happened next. Through candid conversations, we explore people, process, technology, and the tradeoffs of redesigning work.
Expect real examples, honest outcomes, and practical lessons for anyone asking what better work could look like.
Hosted by Jess McDaid. Explore at endofusual.com.

title: The Slow Line: Cozy Train Journeys to Sleep
author: The Slow Line
description:
Welcome to The Slow Line.
Leave the hustle of the day behind and escape into deep relaxation, natural sleep aid, and mindful travel. Step aboard the world's most beautiful and historic railway lines for immersive sleep stories, low-frequency train ASMR, and midnight soundscapes engineered to quiet your mind and cure insomnia.
Hit Follow to never miss a journey, and let the rhythm of the rails carry you into deep, uninterrupted rest every single night.

author: Hire-It-Right Arkansas

title: Advisory Council Podcast
author: Karen Graham
description:
The Advisory Council Podcast brings together members of the Resource Works Advisory Council — leaders from across Canada's energy, natural resource, technology, policy and education communities — for frank conversations about the ideas shaping the country's resource economy.

Hosted by Karen Graham, Chair of the Resource Works Advisory Council, each episode digs into one question with the people working on it: how Canada turns its ideas into companies, how resource projects and Indigenous nations build real partnerships, what it takes to cut red tape without cutting corners, and where Canada's energy advantage goes next.

New episodes every Friday, here and wherever you get your podcasts.

Resource Works — Building Canada's Future: https://resourceworks.com

title: The Coven's Corner
author: The Coven's Corner
description: Real magic for real life. Join best friends Kacey and Dawn every week at The Coven’s Corner, your go-to spot for down-to-earth magic and mystical venting. Whether you’ve been practicing for 20 years or just bought your first tarot deck, we’re breaking down the "how-to" of witchcraft without the gatekeeping. If you’re looking to build a sustainable practice that fits into your busy schedule (and your budget), you’ve found your coven. From pantry spells to moon phases and everything in between, we’re proving that magic doesn't have to be perfect—it just has to be yours.

author: Accenture
description:
Software & Platforms is the world's innovation engine, home to the companies shaping how businesses operate, how consumers engage and how AI scales across every industry. As AI reshapes products, business models, infrastructure and growth strategies, leaders are being forced to reinvent faster than ever before.
This series will explore the technologies, trends and strategic decisions redefining Software & Platforms; from agentic AI and product reinvention to platform growth, infrastructure and new business models. We'll examine what's changing, why it matters and what leading companies are doing to stay ahead.

title: The Dashboard Podcast
author: Southern Sales & Service Co. Ltd.
description:
The automotive world is always moving, and we're here to keep you in the know.

The Dashboard Podcast brings you conversations about cars, automotive brands, industry trends, innovation, and everything happening across the world of automobiles.

From what's new in the industry to the companies and technologies shaping its future, we're exploring it all, one conversation at a time.

title: Reset by Shared Ground
author: Shared Ground
description:
Looking for a fresh way to think about ecology? Reset by Shared Ground brings together ideas, voices, and debates that connect environmental issues to people’s real concerns, choices, and futures.
Reset by Shared Ground, the podcast that grounds ecology in people’s reality.

title: In Divided Times with Hancen Sale
author: WBIR

title: Gut Feelings & Girl Things
author: Gina Scarpino
description:
Gut Feelings & Girl Things

Intuition, hormones, healing & all the things in between.


What do hormones, dead people, God, and gut feelings have in common? Apparently, me.


Welcome to Gut Feelings & Girl Things, the podcast where women's health meets the spirit world, intuition gets loud, and absolutely nothing is off-limits.


I'm Gina Scarpino — psychic medium, medical medium, healer, spiritual mentor, weightlifting fanatic, and loud Italian woman with a lot to say.


We're talking about the stuff women actually want to talk about: hormones, fertility, relationships, healing, the mind-body connection, psychic abilities, predicting the future, God, spirituality, and all those weird little moments when your gut knows something before your brain catches up.


Some episodes will get deep. Some will get weird. Some will make you laugh. And some might make you question everything you thought you knew about your body, your intuition, and the universe.


Expect personal stories, spiritual downloads, honest conversations, a little sarcasm, and the occasional visit from the other side.

Because being a woman is complicated enough. We might as well trust our gut, laugh at the chaos, and figure some shit out together.


Your body has a story. Your soul has a voice. And your intuition? She's got opinions.

Welcome to Gut Feelings & Girl Things. Let's get into it.



Before we dive in, a quick but important disclaimer.

Gut Feelings & Girl Things is intended for informational, educational, and entertainment purposes only.

I'm a psychic medium, medical medium, healer, and spiritual mentor, but I'm not acting as your physician, licensed medical provider, or mental health professional through this podcast.

Any discussions involving women's health, hormones, fertility, medical conditions, or healing are based on personal experiences, general information, guest perspectives, and spiritual beliefs. They are not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any medical condition or replace professional medical advice.

Any psychic readings, intuitive impressions, spiritual messages, or predictions shared on this podcast reflect personal spiritual beliefs and interpretations. They are not guarantees of future events, medical outcomes, or specific results.

Always consult a qualified healthcare professional regarding your individual health, treatment decisions, or medical concerns. Never delay or discontinue medical treatment based on something discussed here.

The opinions and experiences shared by guests are their own and do not necessarily reflect those of the host.

By listening, you understand that this podcast does not establish a medical, mental health, or other licensed professional relationship.

Now that we've covered the important stuff, let's get into it!

title: Breaking The Huddle
author: John, Isaac, and Ryan
description: Breaking The Huddle brings together three lifelong sports fans — John, Isaac, and Ryan — who aren't afraid to speak their minds. From honest opinions and bold hot takes to the latest sports news and biggest headlines, we cover it all. We also dive into the world of sports cards, discussing the latest releases, hobby news, and everything happening in the collecting community. No filters, no sugarcoating — just three guys talking sports and saying what they really think. Join us as we break it all down, one episode at a time!

title: Victory Lane Radio
author: WSPY 107.1
description: Victory Lane has been Chicagoland’s original racing talk show. Locally produced and broadcast right here on WSPY 107.1 and simulcast on WCSJ 103.1 and WLBK 98.9, it covers every corner of motorsports, from the short tracks down the road to the biggest super speedways. Catch up on interviews, race talk and the stories behind the wheel anytime.

title: Pathways to Employment
author: Pathways Employment Help Centre
description: Struggling to find work? Need help understanding the changing work environments? If you want to learn how to be employable and in-demand, our podcast strives to give you the information you need while expanding your knowledge with insightful tips, interviews, and stories. We want to motivate you to take charge of your future career!

title: The Safe Love Podcast with Dr. Shena Manning, LPC
author: safelovepodcast
description: Struggling to feel safe and secure in your relationships? The Safe Love Podcast with Dr. Shena Manning, LPC, is a Christian, Bible-based podcast about emotional safety in marriage, dating, family and everyday relationships. Every other Tuesday, Dr. Shena, a licensed counselor, shares practical tools to help you communicate with care, heal old hurts and rebuild trust. She is co-author of Safe Love: Building Emotionally Secure Relationships That Actually Last.

title: Before the Amen
author: Ryleigh Martinez
description:
Before the Amen is where Scripture meets storytelling.
From royal betrayals and impossible decisions to unlikely heroes and extraordinary acts of faith, the Bible is filled with stories more captivating than fiction.
Join your host, Ryleigh Martinez, as she brings these ancient accounts to life through cinematic narration, historical context, and suspenseful storytelling, all while staying rooted in the truth of God’s Word.
Whether you’re rediscovering familiar passages or hearing them for the first time, Before the Amen invites you to experience the Bible in a whole new way.

title: Meta App Review
author: Kevin
description: This is a test podcast for Meta App Review.

title: Federico Beyond the story
author: Federico Luca Barbarossa
description:
Welcome to Federico: Beyond the Story — real people, real stories and honest conversations.
Hosted by Federico, this podcast explores life, mental health, sobriety, personal journeys, LGBTQ+ experiences and the stories that deserve to be heard.
No judgement. No filters. Just honest conversations that go beyond the surface.
Every story matters. Every voice deserves to be heard.

title: Logic: Life after Work
author: Harj Heer
description:
Logic: Life After Work is the podcast from Logic Financial Services exploring one of life's biggest transitions – what happens when work stops and the next chapter begins.
 
Hosted by two experienced Financial Planners, each episode features honest, engaging conversations with inspiring guests from a wide range of backgrounds. Together, we explore the financial, psychological and personal sides of later life, covering everything from purpose, identity and wellbeing to relationships, adventure, lifelong learning and, of course, money.
 
Whether you're planning for retirement, already enjoying it, or simply thinking about what you want your future to look like, Logic: Life After Work will challenge assumptions, spark new ideas and help you build a retirement that's about far more than just your finances.
 
Because retirement isn't the end of the journey, it's the start of a new one.

title: That Must Suck
author: That Must Suck
description: That Must Suck is hosted by Emily and Louis (accolades pending), two Aries best friends with an eye for the finer things in life such as Oscar Isaac’s full-frontal moments, fancasting the latest A24 release, unhinged women in literature, and the best music to cry in the bath to. Join them on a journey through all things pop culture and listen as they feverishly pursue a life of rest and relaxation. Follow @thatmustsuckpod on Twitter to stay relevant.

title: Drop The Spotlight Presents: The Geek Show
author: Drop The Spotlight
description: Miss Teena, Vic, and Todd discuss fandom, entertainment, gaming, tech, and more throughout each episode.

title: Sleepy Expedition
author: Sleepy Expedition
description:
History told in the quiet hours.
Each episode is a slow expedition to one quiet place: an island monastery in the 820s, a lighthouse on a rock in the North Sea, the edge of the Antarctic ice with Captain Cook. Every story is true and carefully researched, built from the letters, logbooks and drawings that survive, and told gently so you can drift off whenever you are ready.
No cliffhangers, no sudden noises, just a calm voice, a few things worth knowing, and the sounds of faraway places. Early episodes are narrated by a synthetic voice, with mine to follow.

title: The Game of Life and How to Play It (Unlocking Your True Potential)
author: Florence Scovel Shinn
description:
Florence Scovel Shinn, a once-ordinary illustrator in bustling New York City, discovers her extraordinary power to shape her reality after a life-altering divorce. In "The Game of Life and How to Play It," she unveils the secrets of the New Thought philosophy, urging listeners to harness their thoughts and intentions to manifest the life they desire. This inspiring audiobook invites you to embark on a transformative journey of self-discovery and empowerment.

Through practical wisdom and relatable anecdotes, Shinn reveals how your thoughts can steer your destiny. She tackles the central conflict of self-doubt versus self-belief, illustrating how mastering your mindset can lead to profound changes in your relationships, career, and overall happiness. Listeners will find themselves captivated by her engaging storytelling as she shares powerful affirmations and timeless principles that resonate with the Law of Attraction movement.

What if you could unlock the hidden potential within yourself? With Shinn as your guide, you’ll learn to navigate life’s challenges with a renewed sense of purpose. This audiobook offers more than just motivation; it provides actionable insights that encourage you to confront your fears and embrace abundance. Join Florence on this enlightening journey and discover the game of life and how to play it with intention and confidence. Your new reality awaits.

title: But First, Clarity
author: Dixon Schwabl + Company
description:
Marketing has never had more tools, data, channels or opinions. What it could use is a little more clarity.
But First, Clarity is a podcast from Dixon Schwabl + Company for marketing leaders navigating the questions, decisions and tensions shaping the industry.
Hosted by DS+CO Chief Transformation Officer Malorie Benjamin, each episode goes beyond the surface-level take to explore what marketers might be missing, challenge assumptions worth reconsidering and bring real-world perspective to the decisions marketing leaders are making every day.
Expect candid conversations, curious thinking, healthy debate and perspectives from people who have done the work.
Because this isn't another place for hot takes. It's a place for marketing conversations that provoke progress.

title: Adventures of Mister Mann
author: Mister Mann
description:
What started off as an impromptu bedtime story for my son, grew into a beloved nightly routine. My wife liked them so much that she suggested I start a podcast. So here it is: 
Mister Mann tells short, kindhearted stories about his everyday life in Honeysuckle Hollow, with his animal neighbors, the occasional bit of magic, and a whole lot of heart.
If you would like to show your support, please visit https://ko-fi.com/adventuresofmistermann to leave Mister Mann a small tip. 
Mister Mann would love you hear from you. You can email him at adventuresofmistermann@gmail.com
Pop on over to ⁠adventuresofmistermann.substack.com for the full transcripts.

title: Voces de la noche / Voices from the dark
author: America Dominguez ⏐ True crime fanatic
description: ¿Qué pasa cuando se apagan las luces? What really happens after dark? When the world falls asleep and nature quiets down, the unseen comes out to play. Welcome to Voces de la noche / Voices from the dark. A bilingual destination for real paranormal encounters, urban legend, and haunted history, told in both English and Spanish.. As someone who grew up always being curious about “the other side” and even having my own encounters with the paranormal, this topic is something I don’t shy away from. So step into the dark with me, and listen close because some voices can only be heard at night.

title: Euro Vice & Villains
author: Stephen - Your Host
description: Europe's postcards hide a criminal past. Each week, we pull one file from the continent's darkest archives; the heists, syndicates, and outlaws the history books were too polite to keep. Meet the Ringvereine, Berlin's ring-wearing criminal fraternities. Follow Jacques Mesrine, France's Public Enemy Number One, in and out of prison. Step into Marseille's French Connection, where the Guerini brothers turned morphine into an empire. Every villain has a reason, and every vice has a price. The truth was never in the guidebooks. New episodes weekly.

title: Powered by Data
author: MedPro Systems
description: Powered by Data is MedPro Systems’ podcast for clear, candid conversations about the changes shaping Life Sciences, from data integrity and compliance to CRM migrations. Each episode brings together industry experts to share insights, real-world experience and practical guidance to help organizations move forward with confidence.

title: Learn To Trade Properly
author: Share Wealth Systems
description:
You've done the reading. You follow the market. So why don't your results match your effort?
Most experienced investors don't need more information. They need a process with an edge, and the skill to follow it.
For around 30 years, Share Wealth Systems has trained self directed investors to execute rules based systems with an edge, objectively and consistently, in their own account, with their own broker. Hosted by founder Gary Stone.
New episodes weekly on execution, drawdowns and the habits that cost investors money, plus talks with our coaches and long standing members.

title: AI Meets CFO
author: AI Meets CFO
description: Each episode Amendra Pratap sits down with a CFO, finance director, or finance-technology practitioner to talk through how they actually run their function: the tools they rely on, the tech stack decisions behind the scenes, the moments that tested them, and how they're thinking about AI's role in finance's future. No scripts, no sales pitches; just practitioner-to-practitioner conversation for people who make real budget and technology decisions every day. 🔔 Subscribe for new episodes

title: RunTime Realities
author: Rowan Paradox
description: "It works on my machine" is the biggest lie in software engineering. Welcome to Runtime Realities, the podcast for developers and systems architects who are tired of basic tutorials and corporate tech hype. We move past local staging to confront the chaos of real production environments. From the hydration tax of modern rendering frameworks to distributed state synchronization and building guardrails against AI code slop, we dissect the raw architectural trade-offs of software at scale. Subscribe for zero-fluff, highly technical infrastructure deep dives. Production is chaos.

title: Persephone Presents : Lost Olympians
author: Sole Muse Media
description:
Hi guys, this is Persephone, coming to you live from the Underworld.
Everyone knows Zeus, Athena and Aphrodite. But Olympus had staff. There was a god of flattery who never got a single line, and a goddess of ruin Zeus threw off the mountain by her hair. Rumour had a tongue under every feather, and Excuses had a father literally named Afterthought.
I've met every soul that ever came down here, and I'm tired of hearing the same twelve names. So each episode, I'm pulling one forgotten god out of the dark and telling you who they were, where the stories come from, and why the Greeks needed them!

title: MJMG Presents: SHU Radio
author: spudbrooklyn
description: MJMG Presents: SHU Radio is where music, culture, and the business of entertainment connect. Hosted and produced by industry professional SPUDBROOKLYN at SHU Studio, the show features exclusive artist interviews, industry insights, and authentic conversations with artists, executives, and cultural innovators. From emerging talent to established voices, SHU Radio explores the stories, struggles, and successes behind the music while creating opportunities for artists to connect with new audiences. Tune in for real conversations, fresh music, and an inside look at the entertainment industry.

title: The Frequency 107 Podcast

RECORDS and 107.1 AAGRADIO—Making the Invisible Visible.

description: Search Party with Sam Ellis is an independent video journalism project that will investigate and decode the most important and complicated news around geopolitics and global sports.

title: The Merry Heart Cafe
author: NoteSpire Music/Ted Brennan
description:
Welcome to The Merry Heart Cafe—a heartwarming, Bible-based storytelling series written by Ted Brennan and produced by Paul Gibbs for NoteSpire Music.

Inspired by Proverbs 17:22 ("A merry heart doeth good like a medicine"), this audio series follows husband and wife duo, Cookie and Corie, as they step out in faith, leave Gagger’s Diner behind, and open the doors to a cozy new cafe filled with good food, genuine warmth, laughter, and hope.

Every episode offers a gentle reminder that a cheerful heart brings true comfort to a troubled soul. Pull up a chair, grab a warm cup, and enjoy these uplifting stories of faith, community, and fresh beginnings from NoteSpire Music.

title: Rooted Pedagogy
author: Filipe Teixeira
description: Rooted Pedagogy is a podcast that bridges the gap between educational research and classroom practice. In each episode, educators share two or three strategies, routines, or approaches they use with their students, reflecting on what works, what doesn't, and how these practices have evolved over time. Drawing on research from education, psychology, and neuroscience, the conversation connects these real-world experiences to the evidence behind them. The podcast also aims to give greater visibility to the expertise of educators by highlighting the thoughtful, innovative work happeni

title: Somewhere For The Night
author: Ben Carver
description:
Cozy stories for sleep, calm, and a little wonder, brought to life with rich, immersive soundscapes.
Join Atlas, a wandering bear with a warm lantern and a curious heart, as he explores quiet forests, distant stars, and peaceful places to rest.
Gentle bedtime stories for all ages, with soft music, atmospheric sounds, and warm narration that never hurries.
Written and performed by Ben Carver.

title: The Murder Podcast Show
author: The Murder Podcast Show
description:
Join the host Tim his Co Host Criminology Chris & Classroom Jackie as we dive deep into murder cases & Serial Killers minds...we will break down and paint a picture of these horrific scenes throughout the years!

Become a supporter of this podcast: https://www.spreaker.com/podcast/the-murder-podcast-show--7534163/support.

title: The Coaching Room by Maven Coaching
author: Maven Coaching
description:
Real conversations about performance, identity, change and finding your way.
Hosted by Carrie from Maven Coaching, The Coaching Room brings together athletes, coaches, health professionals and people with stories worth sharing.
From motherhood and returning to performance, to injury, identity, career and navigating change — these are conversations about what happens when life shifts, and how we find our way forward.
Never Alone. Find Your Way.

title: Children's Deliverance
author: Maria Dodrill
description: Join us as we journey through Pastor Bev Tucker's Children's Deliverance Manual.

title: Brief-Minded
author: Brief-Minded
description: An attempt to let my thoughts out while also sharing my views on politics, religion, philosophy and psychology and so much more. I try to give an open-minded, analytical and maybe new way of tackling yesterdays, todays and tomorrows issues!

title: Skiba News Nation
author: Jeremiah Skiba
description: Welcome to Skiba News Nation — the independent media show and podcast with more than 150,000 subscribers and growing.Subscribe to our YouTube Channel:https://youtube.com/@SkibaNewsNationHosted by Jeremiah Skiba, & Lynsi Skiba, and Andrew (6G Agenda)! Skiba News Nation dives headfirst into the stories, questions, controversies, conspiracies, current events, and forgotten history that deserve a closer look.From original investigations and hard-hitting commentary to special guests, comedy, hidden history, and conversations mainstream media often refuses to touch, SNN exists for people who are still willing to ask questions.Jeremiah lives by a few simple ideas:“How can you learn if you’re not willing to listen?”“Question Everything. Fear Nothing. Follow the Evidence.”“We’re not here to tell you what to think. We’re here to give you something to think about.”“In this crazy world, sometimes the best thing you can do is pause for a moment, take it all in, and remember to laugh.”At its heart, Skiba News Nation also carries forward the legacy of Jeremiah’s parents, Rob and Sheila Skiba, while proudly honoring the memory of SNN’s beloved producer, Opa, whose wisdom, humor, and unforgettable presence will forever be part of the Skiba News Nation family.As Jeremiah puts it:“After enough loss, you learn how important it is to laugh. Comedy has carried me through some of the darkest moments of my life. Sometimes laughter isn’t just medicine — it’s survival.”And SNN goes far beyond the podcast.Jeremiah and his wife, Lynsi Skiba, are also the creators of TrutherCon — an annual convention built to bring Truthers, researchers, creators, comedians, speakers, and independent thinkers together in the real world.No scripts. No censorship. No sacred cows.Just honest conversations, compelling evidence, plenty of laughs, and a growing community of people who aren’t afraid to question what they’ve been told.Question Everything. Fear Nothing. title: Trust Chats Live
author: Dallase Scott
description: Trust Chats Live explores the human side of leadership—the vulnerability, self-awareness, and courage it takes to build trust in ourselves and with others. In Season 1, we go beyond the strategies and skills of leadership to explore what happens beneath the surface: how we show up under pressure, the patterns that shape our decisions, and the challenges of leading with intention rather than simply reacting. Through honest conversations and thoughtful reflection, we invite you to rethink what it means to lead, connect, and build trust in the workplace.

title: just lance and corbin
author: just lance and corbin
description:
Oh hey. I'm just Lance, and this is my son Corbin. We do media analysis based on franchises and properties that mean a lot to us. I grew up watching a lot of really AMAZING media, and I wanted to find a way to break that down and share it with my son. Shows and movies have changed a lot in the time I've been alive -- some for the better, some for the worst. Generally speaking though, writing principles and good storytelling is timeless, which means I still have a job! 
We've talked at length about Invincible, The Addams Family, Avatar The Last Airbender, and Rick and Morty, and we're still not done. Plenty more content on the way, and if you are a part of that community, I want to hear what you want me to cover! I try to take an analytical approach, but I'll be honest, I'm an Italian from New York -- I get passionate sometimes when things are dumb. Join our community, and enjoy listening. Hopefully you get as much out of it as I put into it :)

title: Forgotten Machines
author: Forgotten Machines
description: Forgotten Machines tells the stories of machines that were built, tested and then forgotten: jet-powered railcars, nuclear merchant ships, Antarctic snow cruisers. Every episode is researched from primary sources, fact-checked twice, and lists its sources in the show notes. Narration uses a synthetic voice. New episodes every two weeks. Also on YouTube: youtube.com/@forgottenmachineschannel

title: Fintechnize
author: Charlie Chang Liu
description:
Fintech, Stablecoins, Agentic Commerce, Agentic Payments, RWA
Interview with industry leaders, entrepreneurs, and investors

title: Chatting with Chance
author: Chance Patterson
description:
Follow along as we chat through the struggles of being a mom, Biblical wife, business owner, entrepreneur, homeschooler, full time RV-er, and more. Never sugar coating - always striving to be better!

Hosted on Acast. See acast.com/privacy for more information.

title: The Second Chance Medway Podcast
author: Second Chance Medway
description:
Behind every statistic is a person, a family and a story.
Join Penny and Salina from Second Chance Medway as they talk openly about the realities of life when making ends meet isn't easy. Together, they'll explore the challenges families face, discover what support is available, and hear how a little help at the right time can make a lasting difference.

title: chai files
author: Dr. Low Chai Ling
description: Honest answers to the questions every woman has about her skin — without the marketing. Hosted by Dr. Low Chai Ling, Medical Director of SW1 Clinic Singapore. Evidence-based skin and aesthetic medicine for professional women who want to make informed decisions about their skin, their face, and how they age. New episodes every two weeks.

title: Around The World Geography: surprising stories from every corner of the globe
author: Around The World Geography
description: Discover fascinating facts, hidden wonders, and surprising stories from every corner of the globe. Around the World Geography brings you quick, engaging insights into geography, culture, and the planet we call home — all in bite-sized videos designed to entertain and educate.

title: Figuring It Out
author: Riva
description: Figuring It Out is a podcast about navigating life without a roadmap. From solo travel and turning 30 to mental health, personal growth, and the everyday limbo we all face, it explores what it means to figure things out as you go.

title: The Purple Pod
author: The University of Manchester Sport
description: Brought to you by UoM Sport and your hosts Matt & Elspeth

title: Break Up With Food
author: Georgie Beames, Psychologist & Coach
description:
You know food isn't really the problem. You've done the diets and the meal plans, maybe the medication or the surgery too, and you still end up in the pantry at 9pm wondering how you got there.
Break Up With Food is for women who are on or off a GLP-1, have had bariatric surgery, or are lifelong dieters, and who are tired of a relationship with food that runs the show. Each episode looks at why you eat when you're not hungry, what a part of you is really reaching for, and how to build a relationship with food that's healthy, secure and actually lasts.
I'm Georgie Beames, a registered psychologist and coach with over 15 years of experience. I've helped more than 3,000 women walk away from a toxic relationship with food and build a new one. No willpower lectures and no food rules. Just honest conversations about what's really going on underneath.

https://georgiebeames.com/

Greyt Big Talk is an arts & entrepreneurship lecture series featuring personal stories and lessons from creative people. Talks are often recorded before live audiences. These testimonies and lessons dispel the notion that creativity is a capacity limited to a select few people, but rather a process that anyone can learn to help accomplish important things. 
The program is hosted by multi-disciplinary creative producer, Thomas Fox.

Confident claims are everywhere: the age of darkness is about to end, a trading bot will make you rich, human-level AI is five years away. Beyond the Hype follows those claims back to their sources and asks what the evidence actually says.
Host Piyush Sarwal, a technologist, former IBM Distinguished Engineer, and graduate instructor in neural networks and NLP, brings an engineer’s curiosity to wide-ranging topics: cosmology and ancient traditions, investing and financial planning, and large language models and the future of AI. author: Singapore Paincare
description:
REAL Stories. REAL Answers. 4 Perspectives. 1 Conversation.
Cannot Tahan is a Singapore health podcast that challenges everyday health beliefs, questions familiar habits and puts common assumptions to the test.
Four personalities. Different professions. Different life stages. Different perspectives.
Expect lively debates, relatable stories, bold questions and questionable logic. Even the doctor gets challenged.
Because some things are worth questioning, not just tahan-ing.

Open Door offers a fresh look into the exclusionary worlds of law and business. Through casual conversation, usually with a coffee or cocktail in hand, we’re here to demystify the legal industry and business world by spotlighting the amazing humans who work (and live) in these spaces.


You’ve got a lot of questions. We’ve got plenty of chairs.


So come in. Our door is wide open.

title: Unscripted Marketing
author: Unscripted Marketing
description:
Two Perspectives. Decades of Experience. One Industry That Never Stands Still.

What happens when two marketing agency owners, each with over 20 years of experience, sit down to talk about the world of marketing?

You get Unscripted Marketing.

We discuss the strategies, trends, tools, and tactics shaping the industry and ask the questions that matter. What's delivering results? What's losing its effectiveness? And what should businesses actually be paying attention to?

Sometimes we'll agree. Sometimes we'll challenge each other. But we'll always bring our experience, opinions, and different perspectives to the conversation.

Because in marketing, there's rarely just one right answer.

Welcome to Unscripted Marketing. Two perspectives. One industry. No script.

Each episode digs into snow, weather, and the people who chase both, from El Niño outlooks and conditions reports to avalanche lessons, backcountry prep, and the one-ski quiver debate. Expect guests from the guiding, forecasting, and ski worlds, and plenty of practical talk to help you plan your season, wherever winter is happening.

description: Meet a dynamic preacher of the undiluted Word of God, whose unwavering faith and inspiring journey will uplift your spirit. Tune in as we delve into the Word of God, His Mercies, and the profound Love of Him. Get ready for a podcast that will ignite your faith and leave you feeling empowered!

title: Dante in Italian, explained in English
author: Andrea Maricelli
description:
Dante's Divine Comedy, read in the original Italian and explained in English, a few lines at a time. Each passage comes first in Italian, then in a plain English translation. After that I look at how the lines sound and at the places where manuscripts and commentators disagree, naming them, from Boccaccio to today's scholars.

We start with the first canto of the Inferno.

I'm Andrea Maricelli, and I teach Italian and Latin in a high school in Milan. More lessons, in Italian, on YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@AndreaMaricelli

Made by creators, for creators.

title: A Christmas Carol
author: NOISER
description:
Join Sir David Suchet for a captivating reading of Charles Dickens’ beloved Christmas classic, A Christmas Carol. On Christmas Eve, the miserly Ebenezer Scrooge is visited by three spirits who take him on a haunting journey through Christmases past, present and yet to come. A journey of memory, consequence and redemption awaits, as Scrooge is given one final chance to change his ways...

Accompanied by original music and immersive sound design, Sir David Suchet brings Dickens’ own performance version to life. This is the abridged version Dickens himself adapted and performed to rapturous audiences in Britain and America. So successful were his live readings that this became, in many ways, the definitive Christmas Carol: the story as Dickens himself loved to tell it.

Gather close to the flickering candlelight and experience this timeless festive tradition as Dickens intended it to be heard.

A Noiser production, narrated by Sir David Suchet. Written by Charles Dickens.

Additional material by Pascal Hughes, Duncan Barrett and Joel Duddell | Executive Producers: Pascal Hughes, Joel Duddell, Katrina Hughes | Produced by Duncan Barrett | Head of Production: Natalie Brook-Reynolds | Recorded and mixed at The Roundhouse Studios | Sound design by Wilfredo Acosta | Sound Supervisors: Tom Pink and Oliver Baines | Compositions by Dorry Macaulay and Oliver Baines | Music performances by Dorry Macaulay, Oliver Baines, Coen Baines.

title: The Bible and the Matrix
author: Brian Metzger and Omar Cumberbatch
description:
What if the world isn't exactly as it seems?
Welcome to The Bible and the Matrix, the podcast where ancient biblical wisdom meets modern-day mysteries. Hosted by Brian Metzger and Omar Cumberbatch, this thought-provoking show explores the intersection of Scripture, spirituality, culture, history, current events, health, psychology, and the unseen forces that shape our world.
Each episode challenges conventional thinking by asking deeper questions about faith, reality, and the narratives we've been taught to accept. Together, Brian and Omar examine everything from biblical prophecy, symbolism, and theology to conspiracy theories, media narratives, health paradigms, historical revisionism, and the search for truth in an increasingly complex world.
Brian brings decades of spiritual formation, biblical scholarship, and monastic wisdom, offering a Genesis-to-Revelation perspective that uncovers the deeper story behind Scripture. Omar contributes the curiosity of a lifelong truth seeker, health coach, and podcaster who isn't afraid to question mainstream assumptions and venture down the rabbit holes that many avoid.
Rather than promoting fear or sensationalism, The Bible and the Matrix encourages thoughtful dialogue, intellectual honesty, and spiritual discernment. Every conversation is grounded in the belief that truth withstands scrutiny, meaningful questions lead to deeper understanding, and authentic community is essential for navigating an age of information overload.
Whether you're exploring Christianity, questioning cultural narratives, interested in biblical symbolism, fascinated by hidden history, or simply searching for a deeper understanding of reality, this podcast invites you to think critically, stay curious, and seek wisdom wherever it can be found.
Expect conversations about:
-Biblical prophecy and Scripture through a fresh lens
-Faith, spirituality, and personal transformation
-The Matrix, worldview, and cultural narratives
-Health, wellness, and uncovering root causes
-Current events and media through biblical discernment
-Conspiracy theories examined with wisdom and balance
-Hidden history, symbolism, and ancient truths
-The psychology of belief, fear, and freedom
-Community, purpose, and living authentically
If you're willing to challenge assumptions, explore uncomfortable questions, and pursue truth with both humility and courage, you've found your community.
Because it's always the right time to know the truth... and the truth will set you free.

title: The Big P with Janice Taylor
author: Janice Taylor
description:
The Big P with Janice Taylor — an Esther & Ruth podcast.

Perimenopause. Pain. Purpose. Possibility. All the Ps — let's talk about all of it.

Not a whisper. A conversation. The Big P is a space for honest conversations about perimenopause and the possibility on the other side: the changes, the questions, the things nobody told us. No perfect answers — just real women, real stories, and a little more room to breathe.

Hosted by Janice Taylor, founder of Esther & Ruth and author of Wisdom. Soul. Startup. — a woman in her own season, asking the questions that too often go unasked. Recorded at Yaletown Podcast Studios, Vancouver, BC.

Be a guest: pr@estherandruth.com · More: podcast.estherandruth.com

USAELL – Learn American English. Practice Every Day. Speak with Confidence.

description:
Construa riqueza. Pense diferente. Invista com sabedoria. Bem-vindo ao The Wealth Mindset, seu podcast para entender dinheiro, investimentos e como construir riqueza a longo prazo. Nossa missão é tornar a educação financeira acessível a todos. Em cada episódio, discutimos:
  • Finanças pessoais e construção de patrimônio.
  • Mercados de ações, ETFs e investimentos de longo prazo.

📖 Biblical teachings to transform your life.

title: The Make Pots, Sell Pots Podcast
author: Jeremie Carroll
description:
You learned how to make the damn pots. Now let's figure out how to sell them.
The Make Pots, Sell Pots Podcast is for potters who love making pottery but could use a little help with the business side. Hosted by Jeremie, a working potter with 15+ years of marketing experience, we're breaking down marketing, social media, pricing, finding customers, and growing a pottery business—without the jargon, overwhelm, or guru nonsense.
Real conversations, practical advice, and ideas you can actually use. Because making great pottery is only half the battle.

title: Spirit + Sass

Spirit + Sass is for people who want to be more self-aware, more intentional, and maybe a little more in control of their energy, without going full crystal-guru. 
We talk mindset, intuition, burnout, relationships, boundaries, habits, and the everyday decisions that actually change your life. 
Expect honest conversations, a few uncomfortable truths, and regular light bulb moments. 
It’s about calling yourself out, getting your life together a bit, and learning to trust your own judgement, without becoming boring, bland or completely insufferable in the process.

description: Fan fiction with full voice cast. The book covers multiple characters across different Star Trek shows shortly after the ending of Lower Decks. The ship visits a world founded right before the wars with a population of roughly 50,000 people, settlers of a Christian faith tradition. title: Open Strings with Tomoko
author: Tomoko Omura
description:
Jazz violin has always lived a little outside the spotlight, which is exactly why its players have so much to say. On Open Strings, jazz violinist Tomoko sits down with fellow violinists from around the world to talk about how they found their way into jazz, how they practice and compose, and what really happens in the moment they improvise.
Each episode is an open, unhurried conversation between musicians: the stories behind the music, the habits behind the sound, and the questions violinists usually only ask each other backstage. Whether you play, teach, or just love the sound of the violin in jazz, pull up a chair.

author: Toni Doman
description: Folk Transmission is a research-based limited podcast series that explores how tradition and technology intersect, using traditional music originating from Cape Breton Island in Nova Scotia, Canada as a lens. Focusing on the region’s Scottish-Gaelic musical threads, this series explores how digital tools and globalization are shaping a music scene that once relied primarily on in-person learning and also considers what these changes may mean for the future of the region’s cultural traditions while discovering how these findings may also relate to traditional music communities worldwide.

title: Farming Full-Time
author: Adam Kuznia
description:
People have no idea what it's like to farm for a living. Farming Full-Time is about all of it: the money, the stress nobody talks about, and the people who keep showing up anyway.
The bills nobody sees from the road. The mental health side of a job where we're taught to be tough while a lot of us are melting down. And the farmers, agronomists and neighbors with stories worth hearing.
I'm Adam Kuznia, farmer at heart and agronomist by trade, from True Grit Agronomy in Hawley, Minnesota. We follow the money and the data, not dogma.

Millions of men are in recovery. Millions of men are fathers. Yet the specific, daily, emotionally demanding work of being a dad in recovery has been largely ignored.

Each week, co-hosts Brandon and Cliff sit down with a guest - a father in recovery, an adult child of an addict, or a clinical expert - and go to the places other podcasts don't. The shame. The amends. The disclosure conversation you've been dreading.

title: Rest Well Devotionals
author: Taylor
description:
Welcome to Rest Well Devotionals with Taylor 🤎

A quiet place to slow down, open God’s Word, and find peace in His presence.

Here you’ll find peaceful Bible readings, honest reflections, and prayer created for the moments when you need encouragement, your mind feels busy, or you simply want to spend some quiet time with God.

Put on a devotional while you’re winding down for the night, getting ready in the morning, journaling, studying, or whenever you need a peaceful reminder of God’s presence.

You don’t need to know the Bible front to back or have the perfect words to pray. Just come as you are.

📖 Scripture
🤎 Real-life reflection
🙏 Prayer
🌙 Peaceful, cozy atmosphere

New devotionals weekly.

Come weary. Leave encouraged. Rest well.

title: Plex ta vie
author: Collège MREX
description:
Animé par Martin Huot, ex-policier devenu formateur et propriétaire de multilogements, Plex ta vie raconte les vraies aventures des investisseurs, des propriétaires et des gestionnaires immobiliers. Pas juste les succès qu’on voit en entrevue : tout le parcours pour y arriver, avec ses défis, ses erreurs et ses moments où c’est loin d’être rose.
Chaque semaine, Martin reçoit des invités de l’univers immobilier, et parfois d’ailleurs, qui se livrent sur leurs bons et mauvais coups, leurs leçons et leurs fiertés. Avec Bob l’investisseur, son fidèle acolyte qui encaisse les coups de pelle à la place de la communauté, et son tableau pour des capsules pédagogiques, le podcast mise sur une idée simple : on apprend mieux quand on a du fun. Et chaque épisode se termine par une tape dans le dos, parce qu’on en reçoit rarement.
Que tu sois locataire, que tu habites encore chez tes parents, que tu commences dans l’immobilier ou que tu aies 20 ans d’expérience, c’est pour toi.
Un podcast propulsé par le Collège MREX.

title: The Student in the Gap: a parent advocacy podcast
author: Liz | Parent and Education Advocate
description: 👋 Hello & Welcome to The Student in the Gap, a parent-led podcast exploring neurodiversity in Australian education. We’ll have honest conversations about what happens when a child’s needs aren’t fully understood, the challenges parents face when advocating for their children, and the changes that could make education more inclusive and supportive. Through personal stories, parent advocacy and future guest interviews, The Student in the Gap is a space to ask questions, challenge assumptions, inspire change and build a community where parents don’t have to feel alone.

description: Welcome to Beyond the Balloons! We share ideas, tips, and inspiration for beautiful events and celebrations. From balloon decorations and party backdrops to weddings, baby showers, birthdays, and corporate events, discover simple ways to make every occasion special. Tune in for creative decoration ideas, event trends, and helpful tips for planning memorable celebrations.

title: The Stillness Suite
author: Tameca Boney
description: The Stillness Suite is a faith-centered podcast for the woman who's gotten really good at carrying everything—but is learning that she doesn't have to. Hosted by Tameca Boney, we make room for honest conversations about faith, healing, ambition, relationships, womanhood, purpose, and the quiet work of becoming. Because stillness isn't about doing nothing. It's about making room—room to hear God, room to heal, room to reflect, and room to become. Come in. Get comfortable. Make some room.

description: Here will be my ideas and speculations in audio format. Welcome! Each surah is covered from start to finish across several episodes, so you can follow along like a class. New episodes are posted twice a day. Dr. Nasser holds a Ph.D. from the International Islamic University of Malaysia (IIUM).

title: Breaking Spirits
author: Sofonisba Merula and Vesta Vaingloria
description: Every bottle contains a history, and Sofi and Vesta are going to get to the bottom of each, figuratively and literally. In this series we explore the cultural histories that spirits, liquors, distillers, and cocktails carry with them and into our own imbibing experiences. Why is Fernet the bartender’s shot? Why are Corpse Revivers #1-3 seemingly unrelated drinks? How does Campari secretly own everything? We don’t necessarily have the answers, but we’re going to BS about it and break some spirits.

title: Jack Mind Chaos
author: Jack Damascus III
description:
🧠 Welcome to Jack Mind Chaos!
Where the chaos of the mind meets the journey of self-discovery.Jack Mind Chaos is a podcast dedicated to exploring mental health, psychology, emotional well-being, personal growth, and the complexities of the human mind.From anxiety, stress, overthinking, and emotional struggles to self-confidence, relationships, and self-improvement, we dive into the topics that shape our thoughts, feelings, and everyday experiences.Through honest conversations, interesting perspectives, and thought-provoking discussions, we aim to break the stigma surrounding mental health and remind everyone that it's okay not to have everything figured out.Whether you're navigating difficult emotions, searching for inner peace, or simply curious about how the human mind works, this podcast is a space for reflection, learning, and growth.🌱 Understand Your Mind.
🧩 Embrace Your Chaos.
🔥 Rebuild Yourself.Jack Mind Chaos — Because Understanding Yourself Is the Beginning of Everything.

title: She Evolves with Nnenna Lucy
author: Nnenna Lucy
description: Knowing the depth of God’s investment in our lives is not enough, we have to sit for the seed to watered and nurtured as we navigate through life. Life can get messsyyyy but we serve a God who is always willing and ready to sit in the mess with us. Let’s evolve together, Sis.

title: The Hell I Won’t
author: Wade Skeen
description:
There's the hunt everybody sees; the sunrise, the pile pics, the grip’n grins, the curated social media. 

Everybody smiling like it played out perfectly.

And then there’s everything you DON’T see.

The Money. The Mistakes.The Long Days. The decisions: the good ones and the ones that seemed like a damn fine idea at the time.

And somewhere in the middle of all that, there's a man trying to run an outfitting business with his wife.

We talk hunting and conservation, the business behind it, the people that make it worth it, and the ones that make you question your life’s choices.

We sure as hell don’t claim to be perfect or pretend we get it right every time. Our answers might not be politically correct or what you'd expect. We'll probably step on a few toes but no topic’s off limits, no stories left untold.

And when somebody says “you probably shouldn’t talk about that…”

THE HELL I WON’T.

description:
Honest conversations about figuring out adulthood, growth, faith, relationships and becoming. 🧡
Conversations with Sharon explores the real questions we face as we grow: friendship, uncertainty, comparison, healing, purpose, dreams, decisions and trusting God when life doesn't go as planned.
No pretending to have it all figured out. Just honest reflections, thoughtful conversations and real-life questions.
Pull up a chair. Let's talk.

description: Leaders & Engineers episodes are about accomplished scientists and engineers who proved to be leaders and either lead teams of scientists and engineers or running engineering or R&D departments. title: Humble Followers of Christ
author: Humble Followers of Christ
description:
Hi there!  Welcome to ”The Humble Followers of Christ” podcast!  I’m just an average member of the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-Day Saints following promptings from the Lord to share insights and spiritual lessons I’ve received.  
This podcast is for those striving to be the ”humble followers of Christ” spoken of in 2 Nephi 28: 14, ”They wear stiff necks and high heads; yea, and because of pride, and wickedness, and abominations, and whoredoms, they have all gone astray save it be a few, who are the humble followers of Christ; nevertheless, they are led, that in many instances they do err because they are taught by the precepts of men.”
This podcast is NOT meant to find fault with the church or any of its teachings - rather it is meant to identify the precepts of men that often creep into our teachings due to our fallen nature, and seek what the Lord has said through his holy scriptures. 
Thank you for being here - I hope this podcast blesses you and helps you come nearer to the Lord Yeshua.  Pray about all that is shared, and He will help you sort out the truth of it all.  
Much love,
Anonymous

Moments of Tafakkur is an AUCOSMOS podcast for careful reflection on faith, life, the human mind, technology, and the questions that shape how we live.
Beginning with the Qur’an and Sunnah where they speak, each episode explores ideas with curiosity, intellectual honesty, and care—distinguishing revelation from scholarship, interpretation, and personal reflection.
This is not a space for hurried certainty or easy answers. It is an invitation to pause, think deeply, learn humbly, and return to what is true.
Reflect deeply deeply. Build meaningfully.

title: One Nugget

description:
What if a few honest nuggets of truth could actually shift something inside you this week?
I'm Ben Franklin. I am not a theologian or a preacher. I'm simply someone who remains open to the nuggets of insight revealed by the Spirit of Truth that dwells within me. I share real lessons I have learned and lived so you walk away with nuggets of truth you can actually use and grow closer to God.
I believe that loving God, loving others, and loving yourself can only be found through our awareness of the eternal love that God has for us.
Subscribe to One Nugget Podcast and join a "Love Revolution "

title: Point Hope Presbyterian
author: Point Hope Presbyterian
description:
Welcome to the Point Hope Presbyterian Podcast, where weekly sermons and teachings are shared to encourage faith, provide clarity, and invite a deeper understanding of the gospel of Jesus Christ.

Point Hope Presbyterian Church is located in Charleston, South Carolina, and gathers each Sunday at 10:00am at 160 Fairbanks Drive. Worship is centered around a thoughtful, gospel-driven liturgy that reflects both the holiness of God and His nearness, creating space for believers to grow and for those exploring faith to engage and learn.

Rob Hamby serves as Pastor of Point Hope. A native of Greenville, South Carolina, he is a graduate of The Citadel and Covenant Theological Seminary and has spent over two decades in ministry. Rob and his wife Kendall have been married since 1995 and have two children.

Each episode is designed to bring glory to God, strengthen believers, and offer a clear and approachable understanding of the Christian faith.

title: Hope City Presbyterian

title: The Binge: What Happened to the Harrisons?
author: Sony Music Entertainment
description:
From the outside, 3635 Pitch Pine Crescent looked like the kind of home where nothing bad could happen, the gathering place for every birthday and holiday. Until, one spring night when tragedy struck. In less than five years, three people would end up dead in the same house. Each time, the authorities found a way to explain it away. But the family who loved them knew something was wrong.

Host Amy Dempsey Raven, an investigative reporter for the Toronto Star, spent more than a decade asking what really happened inside that house? Binge all episodes of What Happened to the Harrisons? now by subscribing to The Binge. Visit ⁠⁠⁠The Binge Crimes⁠⁠⁠ on Apple Podcasts and hit ‘subscribe’ or visit ⁠⁠⁠GetTheBinge.com⁠⁠⁠ to get access.

The Binge – feed your true crime obsession.

author: Coach Dwayne
description: Life in Every Lane with Coach Dwayne is about the lessons, challenges, and experiences that shape us through the different areas of life. As a man of faith, husband, track and field coach, and business owner, Coach Dwayne shares real conversations about faith, marriage, coaching, business, money, personal growth, setbacks, purpose, and lessons he's still learning along the way. Some episodes begin on the track; others explore everyday life and relationships. This isn't about having all the answers—it's about learning, growing, and navigating every lane of life.

title: 40 Before 40: 40 Life Lessons Before Turning 40
author: Brit
description: I’m about to turn forty, and nobody gave me a manual. So I’m making one. 40 Before 40 is a limited mini-cast: forty life lessons, one a day, for forty days, before I hit the big four-oh. Short enough to listen to while making your morning coffee, long enough to land the punch. No guru energy, no ten-step framework. Just a woman who’s made many of the mistakes already, sharing what she’s figured out about decisions, confidence, friendship, ambition, and living the life you actually want. Stay curious, chase your joy, and age gratefully.

title: The Reel
author: clqisp@samiahrafnirob.com
description:
The Reel tells the true stories behind the movies that shaped our world. Each episode, host Nirob takes one film, one filmmaker, or one moment in cinema — the first films, Charlie Chaplin, Citizen Kane, Casablanca, Hitchcock, Kurosawa, Star Wars — and rebuilds it: the film and the people who made it, the making, the screen, and the legacy it left.

From the magicians of early cinema to the golden age of Hollywood, from the silent era to the blockbuster, from animation to the largest film industry in the world, The Reel is about the art form that defined the twentieth century — how movies are made, why they move us, and how a strip of celluloid became the world's shared dream. Meticulously researched, honest about what is documented and what is legend. Clean and suitable for all ages. A new story every week

title: Made For The Table
author: Lake Geneva Country Meats
description:
The best part of having people over is getting to enjoy their company. Let’s make that easier.

Made for the Table is a food, drinks, and entertaining podcast with longtime friends Nick and Bridget. Each episode starts with an occasion and something to sip, then gets into what to serve, what to prep ahead, and where you can save yourself some fuss.

From Thanksgiving dinner to game-day snacks, Friendsgiving to New Year’s Eve at home, we share food ideas, drink pairings, and practical hosting advice, along with a few stories from our own tables.

Pull up a chair. We’ll help you put something good on the table so you can enjoy the occasion.

title: Journey Through Life podcast 🌱
author: Oguntade Faith Ayomikun
description:
Journey Through Life podcast is a faith based mental health podcast for everyone journeying through life. Life is a journey and as we go in it, we encounter situations, challenges, struggles which shake our faith in God. As believers, we need to hold unto the truth in God’s word that he’s right there in it with us, holding our hands through the issues of life.
This is that podcast that builds the consciousness in you that God cares about your whole being and you don’t have to do life all by yourself.
Journey through life with God.🕊️
IG, TikTok,YouTube: Journey Through Life podcast

Whether you're seeking inspiration, guidance, or real-life perspectives, Talk with Victoria offers conversations that encourage growth and empower listeners.

Whether you are a child, a parent or simply someone who loves a good story at night, press play, get comfortable and let your imagination do the rest.

description: You don't have to quit forever. Just don't drink today. A daily morning show for people living alcohol-free: one idea, one practical move for today's hardest moment, and the pledge — post your day count in the comments. From the One More Day trilogy by Jack Mercer: How to Stop Drinking, Staying Alcohol-Free, and Life Alcohol-Free — get the books wherever books are sold.

title: Preaching With Prince
author: Prince
description:
Preaching with Prince is a Christian podcast that focuses on real
conversations about faith, life, and what it looks like to follow Jesus in everyday
situations. Hosted by Prince Zala, the show covers topics like growing in your faith,
dealing with struggles, relationships, and learning how to trust God through different seasons of life. The goal of the podcast is to create a space where people can learn more about Jesus, grow in their relationship with God, and hear honest conversations about what living out your faith actually looks like. You're faith journey doesn't have to be strong!

title: Meno Files
author: Bernie Brown
description: Meno Files is a podcast helping African women navigate perimenopause, menopause and beyond through expert insights, real-life stories and practical advice. In many African cultures, menopause remains taboo, often hidden behind euphemisms or left unspoken altogether. But that is beginning to change. Across the continent, women are starting to talk more openly about the challenges of midlife – at home, at work and in their social lives. We’re here to further those conversations, ask the questions that matter and help women find the information, understanding and community they deserve.

title: Men Of Substance
author: Jamul Deon Giles
description:
Men of Substance - Sunday Smoke
Real men. Real talk. No filter.
Sunday Smoke is the weekly roundtable from Men of Substance — where brotherhood meets truth over cigars and drinks. Every Sunday night, we pull up a chair and have the conversations men actually need: relationships, loyalty, fatherhood, health, sex, money, faith, and why we stay, leave, or level up.
We were created to elevate men to their full purpose and potential. This is educational, transparent, and unapologetically honest — master builders sharpening each other.
If you're looking for surface-level podcast talk, this ain't it.

title: Beauty, Backed by Science | The Medical Guide to Aesthetics, Injectables, and Wellness for Women Who Want Real Results
author: Amy Hupe, NP-C | Board Certified Nurse Practitioner specializing in Aesthetic and Wellness Medicine
description:
You know the feeling. You have done the research, watched the videos, tried the serums, and still feel like you are guessing. You want to invest in your skin and your health, but you do not know who to trust, what actually works, or whether what you are spending money on is backed by anything real.
That is exactly why this podcast exists.
Beauty, Backed by Science is hosted by Amy Hupe, a Board Certified Nurse Practitioner and expert in aesthetic and wellness medicine, and the founder of The Downtown Wellness Spa. Each episode, Amy breaks down the science behind aesthetic treatments, regenerative therapies, and skin longevity in a way that actually makes sense, so you can stop guessing and start investing in what works.
Whether you are curious about Botox for the first time, exploring peptides and longevity therapies, or trying to cut through the noise on what skincare products actually do, this podcast is your no fluff guide to looking and feeling your best from the inside out.
New episodes drop on Fridays. Subscribe so you never miss one.

description:
Behind every innovation, acquisition, and growth strategy in CASE is a business decision. What separates the ones that succeed? 

Business of CASE explores the strategies, market forces, and leadership decisions shaping the coatings, adhesives, sealants, and elastomers industry. 

Hosted by Crystal Morrison, Ph.D., a specialty materials industry veteran with deep experience spanning science, innovation, and commercial strategy, Business of CASE brings an insider's perspective to the decisions shaping the industry. She draws on her technical expertise and business experience to go beyond the obvious questions and uncover what it really takes to compete, grow, and create value. 

From shifting customer expectations and industry consolidation to innovation, commercial strategy, and operational challenges, Crystal goes beyond the headlines to uncover what's working, what's changing, and what leaders need to rethink. 

Each episode delivers fresh perspectives and practical insights, giving listeners an idea to act on, an assumption to challenge, or a decision to approach differently. 

Business of CASE is a weekly podcast from Progressio Media, the team behind The Chemical Show, the #1-ranked business podcast in the chemical industry.

I was kidnapped to Saudi Arabia as a child.
Naturally, I turned the experience into a one-woman comedy show.
Then something unexpected happened. Other people who’d been kidnapped as children started finding me.
So this is where the conversation carries on.
I’m a writer, actor and trained counsellor, which means I’m professionally qualified to sit with difficult feelings and personally qualified to make inappropriate jokes about them.
I’ll tell you mine. I want to hear yours.
No trauma porn. No inspirational music swelling underneath.
Probably some swearing.

description: SHAKESPEARE WAS A WORD STAR - and so are you! Suitable for use as a word lullaby for babies... for adults and children in need of a bedtime ritual... for those looking to memorize or understand the sonnets... or for anyone requiring a gentle reset at any time of day. All 154 sonnets will ultimately be represented here in numerical order. Episodes are brief, focusing on the pure joy of the poetry - free of scholarly interpretation. A Note from Lucy: After creating the trailer and first episode, I had a life-changing audio masterclass, which showed me how I could achieve a much better sound quality. I've decided not to record any more episodes at present until I upgrade my audio equipment. Thank you for your interest in this project, and I look forward to sharing more with you soon!

author: Brighton
description: Learn German from zero with Sam. Berlin, Baby! is a story-based German course for English speakers, from A1 all the way to C1. Sam Taylor, a software developer from Lusaka, Zambia, has just landed in Berlin with a new job and almost no German. You follow his new life chapter by chapter, explained in English and German. Every new word comes slowly, then at normal speed, then it's your turn: shadow out loud in the gaps and practise speaking with short drills and role plays. Seven short episodes per chapter, one a day. All you need is your ears and your voice. Voices created with ElevenLabs AI.

title: Philosophical Prescription
author: Philosophical Prescription
description: Ancient thinkers, everyday worries. Philosophical Prescription brings the wisdom of Epictetus, Seneca, Rumi, Pascal and many others into calm conversations about anxiety, comparison, loneliness and meaning. Each episode: one worry, one old story, one prescription for daily life. AI voice; not a substitute for medical or psychological treatment.

title: The Baycrest Brief
author: Baycrest Consultants
description:
Every institution has a story about money. Too often, it ends with an expense that’s gone once it’s paid. The Baycrest Brief tells a different story.
In short, story-driven episodes, we explore how health systems, university athletic departments and private clubs turn compensation, retention and philanthropy into capital that keeps working.
No jargon. No sales pitch. Just clear stories you can share with your board.
Stories. Strategy. Capital.
BaycrestConsultants.com
Educational only - not tax, legal or investment advice.

title: The J Squared Show
author: The J Squared Show
description: The J Squared Show is a heartfelt, real-life conversation space where faith meets everyday living. Hosted with authenticity and warmth, the show dives into the highs, lows, and lessons that come with balancing faith, family, and life’s challenges. Each episode explores how God shows up in both the ordinary and the unexpected—offering encouragement, perspective, and hope for listeners navigating their own journeys. Where faith and family meet real-world challenges.

title: Carried Through: Evidence, Advocacy and the Fight for Every Patient
author: Dr. Valencia Hood-Humphrey
description:
What happens when someone finally fights for you?


That question sits at the heart of Carried Through, a podcast about evidence-based patient advocacy, health equity, and the tools every patient deserves but most never receive.


Dr. Valencia Hood-Humphrey, DrPH, MSc, BCPA, is a Doctor of Public Health, a scholar-practitioner in evidence-based practice and implementation science, and a Board Certified Patient Advocate. As Founder & CEO of Insightful Doc™ Consulting, LLC, she brings extensive experience across biopharmaceutical quality, regulatory, and medical affairs. She knows how the system builds treatments from the inside, and exactly where it loses sight of the person waiting for them.


Before she was a scientist, an industry professional, or a patient advocate, Dr. Valencia was a child who was misdiagnosed. What was dismissed as a stomach virus became a ruptured appendix, emergency surgery, and an uncertain prognosis. She remembers her father carrying her through the emergency room doors.

Carried Through: Evidence, Advocacy and the Fight for Every Patient is for patients, families, and communities who deserve both the evidence and someone in their corner.

Learn more at insightfuldoc.com. Follow on Instagram: @insightfuldocllc

Produced by Insightful Doc™ Consulting, LLC.

title: Writers Block with M.
author: M
description: Welcome to Writer’s Block with M, where real conversations meet real experiences. We explore love, trust, faith, healing, relationships, personal growth, and the stories that shape our lives. Through honest conversations and meaningful reflections, we discover the lessons that make us who we are. Every story matters. Every voice deserves to be heard, because every one of us has a story.

title: The Level Par Podcast
author: Tom Layman
description: The Level Par Podcast is more than a podcast about golf. It’s about the people behind the game. The teachers, the grinders, the comeback stories, and the moments when golf becomes more than just golf. Hosted by Tom Layman, author of the new novel, Level Par.

title: Inside Castilla
author: Inside Castilla
description: A Real Madrid Castilla podcast. Covering the stars of tomorrow, today. Hosted by Sam Sharpe, Hridyam Arora, Ruben Skjerping and Kristofer McCormack.

title: The "Matt Said That" Podcast!
author: Matt Winchell
description: Talks that matter, and talks that don't! Techie, Nerdy, Businessie, type stuff

title: Jesus & Joy Radio Revue
author: Jason Whitehorn
description:
Welcome to the Jesus & Joy Radio Revue, broadcasting from beautiful downtown Crump, USA!
Join Jason Whitehorn and the peculiar residents of Crump for old-fashioned radio comedy, ridiculous characters, fictional news, outrageous sketches, and unexpected laughs.
But beneath the silliness is something real: honest conversations about Jesus, biblical truth, faith, and the wonderfully messy business of being human.
Where the signal is questionable, the people are peculiar, but the Good News is always true.
Keep following Jesus. Keep choosing joy!

title: primeDX - the magazine for curious minds
author: Sandra Tutel
description: Where does real curiosity lead you? The primeDX podcast brings the pages of primeDX magazine to life, capturing stories from the road, the lab, and the wider world. We dive into intelligent mobility and in-depth vehicle reviews, unpack groundbreaking technology, and share fresh perspectives on modern life, culture, and global travel. Whether exploring how innovation reshapes everyday routines or uncovering destinations worth the journey, primeDX is your go-to guide for living with curiosity and purpose.
